facts.text: An overall field rate is calculated by summing w_i times p_i over strata, where w_i is the exposure share of stratum i.
facts.quote: An overall field rate is the sum over strata of w_i times p_i, where w_i is the exposure share of stratum i.

facts.text: Uncertainty in each stratum's exposure share w_i, such as how often dense dust occurs at dusk, must be reported alongside the overall field rate.
facts.quote: The uncertainty in w_i (how often is there dense dust at dusk?) must be reported alongside the rate.
